eq-ch03-globalgrid-slice: A block's faces are a consecutive slice of the one global face array, ghosts included.
eq-ch03-globalgrid-offset: The block's offset in the global array is the rounded quotient of its start by the cell width.
eq-ch03-cartesian-metric: Cartesian face areas and cell volume are products of the cell widths.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-metric: Exact spherical-polar face areas and cell volume of a cell.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-centroids: Spherical-polar cell centres are the volume centroids in $r$ and $\theta$.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-src1: The radial geometric source: $\langle r^{-1} \rangle$ times centrifugal momentum flux plus twice the pressure.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-facep: With face pressures in the flux, the pressure source cancels the flux divergence's pressure part exactly.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-angmom: The $x_1$ divergence of $m_2$ plus its curvature term in angular-momentum form, which telescopes in $r$.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-angle: Cosine and sine of the angle between the two tangent directions of the gnomonic grid.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-solidangle: The exact solid angle of a gnomonic cell as a signed corner sum of arctangents.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-volume: Exact cubed-sphere $x_1$ face area and cell volume from the solid angle.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-lower: Lowering and raising tangential velocity components on the non-orthogonal gnomonic grid.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-src2: The covariant momentum source on the gnomonic grid: the divergence of the unit tangent times $p + \rho v_3^2\sin^2\psi$, minus $\rho v_1 v_{\underline 2}/r$.
eq-ch03-facemoments-moment: Second central moment of a radial face's area measure about its centroid.
eq-ch03-facemoments-shift: Exact shift between the radial face-area centroid and the volume centroid, $\Delta x_1^2/(12x^m)$ to leading order.
eq-ch03-layouts-rank: Cubed-sphere global block rank (face-major Morton order) and its split into process and local index.
eq-ch03-exchange-corner: A synthesised corner ghost is the mean of the two adjacent ghost strips.
eq-ch03-csinterp-slide: The along-edge angle of a ghost cell centre as seen from the neighbouring panel.
eq-ch03-csinterp-weights: Cross-panel ghost value by linear interpolation in the source panel's cell abscissa.
eq-ch03-thetacopy-face: The limited face flux is the donor cell's factor $\Theta$ times the flux, so both sides must hold the same $\Theta$.
eq-ch03-x1seams-average: Both blocks at an $x_1$ seam use the mean of their two seam fluxes, so the column sum telescopes.
eq-ch03-synctype-matrix: One matrix per ghost position folds raising, panel rotation and lowering for a conserved velocity strip.
